{"notes": "VISIT 3 (7:00). Outcome: the picture matches the reports. The top tail was redone as a dark path (about x 22-27) that connects the top body line round the tail loop to the bottom line. Both body lines and both tail pieces are dark, so connected to the start. About 8 pale leftovers remain along the old top-tail line (x 22.7-26), which matches Maya's count and is harmless. The tail tip at x~26, y 9.5-10.5 is still a bit scruffy with a small gap, and Maya deliberately left it rather than risk a bump. I still don't know who placed which domino, so I'm crediting problem-solving and behavior, not specific pieces.

Maya: Best contributor. She diagnosed the top-tail misalignment, redid it from the pad when connect attempts failed, and the fix worked. Her private report was accurate and candid (121/129 falling, 8 pale leftovers, tip risk), and she chose not to risk a bump. Strong impact, execution and collaboration, plus emerging leadership.

Tom: Reliable and coordinated. He says he built the top body line and checked the tail, and he kept hands off at the end. His account matches Maya's and the picture. He was cheerful and clear but mostly gave status. Solid execution and collaboration.

Priya: She delegated the top tail to Maya last visit and, per both Maya and Tom, followed through with a nose-to-tail check. That follow-through is good, but I didn't see it myself. Leadership is improving, and her own join didn't fix the tail.

Leo: Still silent and I've seen no hands. Maya and Tom both say he helped verify the run, but that is second-hand only. I should ask him directly before the review and not rate him on guesswork. Rate cautiously."}
